request: Analyze GSE267512 for PMID 39393048 (Bioavailable testosterone and androgen receptor activation, but not total testosterone, are associated with muscle mass and strength in females.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.
decision_maker: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5[1m]) Claude Code subagent session

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA, Ribo-Zero Gold), vastus lateralis, Kallisto GRCh38 gene counts (S2.12.6.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: untrained pre-menopausal females, 12-week resistance training; 27 completed; Fig 7 legend: n = 35 pre-training, 27 post-training (S2.2.p1, FIG7)
final.primary_estimand: within-participant change in vastus lateralis gene expression after 12 weeks of resistance training (POST vs PRE), DESeq2 ~ ID + timepoint
planned_contrasts: timepoint POST vs PRE (S3.6.p1, FIG7; paper: 214 DEGs, 122 up, 92 down at FDR < 0.05)
final.gene_filter: text: mean across samples <= 10 RPM removed (63%), 14,979 genes kept (S2.12.6.p1); authors' code: rowMeans(counts) >= 10
final.paper_method: DESeq2 ~ ID + timepoint (S2.14.p6); results() defaults (alpha 0.1) per authors' GitHub script
final.paper_results: 214 DEGs (122 up, 92 down); RPS6KC1 up 11% FDR < 0.01; TRIM63, FBXO32, TRAF6, FOXO1, FOXO3 unchanged; AR mRNA FDR = 0.956 (S3.6.p1, S3.4.p2, S3.3)
final.secondary_analyses_not_reproduced: ChEA3 TF enrichment on DEGs; gene association with total testosterone (no hormone values in GEO)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.14.p6 states DESeq2 with Genes ~ ID + timepoint, ID for repeated measures; S2.14.p7 FDR-adjusted P < 0.05 with no fold-change rule; S3.6.p1 reports 214 DEGs (122 up / 92 down). The pre/post resistance-training contrast is the exercise estimand the paper intends.

checks: GEO: 57 female vastus lateralis samples, PRE/POST of a 12-week resistance training program, Kallisto GRCh38, contact Danielle Hiam (author D.H. performed transcriptomics, S7.p1)
